title: Simeon and Anna Wait for Jesus
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Mary and Joseph took baby Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem. There they gave thanks for Him.
A good old man named Simeon lived in Jerusalem. The Holy Ghost had promised he would see the Savior before he died. He waited and waited.
That day the Holy Ghost led Simeon to the temple. He took baby Jesus in his arms. “Now I can go in peace,” he said. “I have seen Your Savior!”
p2: An old woman named Anna prayed in the temple day and night. When she saw Jesus, she gave thanks. She told others about Him.
Simeon and Anna waited a long time, and Heavenly Father kept His promise. When you wait, keep trusting Him.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
